## Description

Please include a summary of the change and which issue it addresses. Also list any dependencies that were added or modified.

Fixes / Closes #(issue number)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] New aptitude solver or CV feature extractor
- [ ] Performance enhancement or cache optimization
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Test suite expansion

## How Has This Been Tested?

Please describe the tests that you ran to verify your changes.

- [ ] Ran automated test suite via `python -m unittest discover tests -v`
- [ ] All tests passed with 0 errors and 0 failures
- [ ] Tested live capture on local machine with provider: (e.g. Ollama, Gemini)

## Checklist:

- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings or unhandled exceptions

- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes
